slips.name: The Cat on the Awning
slips.summary: A tabby will not come down from Hesta's awning, and the market is tired of hearing about it.

steps.line: The tabby comes down when you look up. Hesta says that was the whole job.

slips.name: The Lost Ribbon
slips.summary: Rowan lost a ribbon off the notice board. He will not admit it matters.

steps.line: Rowan pins the ribbon back and pretends he never asked.

slips.name: Pipp's Lost Line
slips.summary: The crier forgot the third slip's name and is shouting the wrong one.

steps.line: Pipp hears the right name, nods, and starts over louder.

slips.name: The Inn Lamp
slips.summary: Maelin's door lamp keeps going out. She wants someone to stand under it and say it is lit.

steps.line: The lamp holds. Maelin says that is as much magic as she trusts.

slips.name: Smoke in the Kitchen
slips.summary: Bram's pot boiled over and the lane thinks the kitchen is on fire.

steps.line: Bram waves you at the pot. It is soup, not a fire. He is still angry.

slips.name: The Pup in the Straw
slips.summary: Something small in Lila's shop will not stop crying, and she will not leave the door.

steps.line: Lila finds the pup under the straw. It was never lost. It was hiding from the bell.

slips.name: The Stuck Bucket
slips.summary: Tam's bucket is stuck again. He wants a second pair of hands and no advice.

steps.line: The bucket comes up. Tam says he will fix the rope. He will not.

slips.name: The Missing Bridle
slips.summary: Tess hung a bridle on the wrong peg and the horse is taking it personally.

steps.line: Tess moves the bridle. The horse forgives her, which is more than she expected.

slips.name: The Dark Lantern
slips.summary: One lantern in the alley is out. Kit will not walk that stretch until it is not.

steps.line: Kit lights it with a stub of candle and acts like you did the brave part.

slips.name: A Candle for No Name
slips.summary: Nia wants a candle lit for someone who came back and would not give a name.

steps.line: Nia lets you light it. She does not ask who you were thinking of.

slips.name: Pike's Net
slips.summary: Pike needs the net held while he ties the last hole. He has been saying that for days.

steps.line: The knot holds. Pike says the sea can have it now.

slips.name: Chalk the Gate
slips.summary: Holt wants today's mark on the gate post before the watch changes.

steps.line: Holt checks the chalk, grunts, and lets the next watch through.

slips.name: The Orchard Cat
slips.summary: Mira's cat is in a tree and will only come down for someone who is not Mira.

steps.line: The cat drops onto your shoulder like it planned this. Mira is not surprised.

slips.name: The Unsealed Pouch
slips.summary: Voss has a pouch with a broken seal and wants a witness before he opens it.

steps.line: Voss opens it in front of you. Coin, and a note he will not read aloud.

slips.name: Fenn's Empty Peg
slips.summary: A shift peg is bare and Fenn wants it said out loud that nobody took the work.

steps.line: Fenn writes the peg closed. Day work is not your problem. He looks relieved.

slips.name: The Door on Home Street
slips.summary: Wren says a door has not opened since yesterday. She wants someone to knock.

steps.line: The neighbor answers, embarrassed and alive. Wren pretends she knew.

slips.name: The Dropped Flag
slips.summary: Yenn's flag came off the watch in the wind. She can see it. She cannot leave the bell.

steps.line: You get the flag back up. Yenn rings once, for the record.

slips.name: The Quarry Whistle
slips.summary: Dorr is one whistle short at the count. He will not start the day until he is not.

steps.line: The whistle was under a cart. Dorr counts again, and the day starts.

slips.name: Walk Nell Home
slips.summary: Nell is stuck where the river lamps end. Maelin has a bed if someone walks her in.

steps.line: Nell takes your arm like she has been waiting for a specific stranger.
Maelin puts a bowl down before Nell sits. The walk is the job.

slips.name: Kit to the Chapel
slips.summary: Kit has a message that is not for you. Nia is the only person he will hand it to.

steps.line: Kit falls in beside you and does not explain the paper.
Nia takes the paper and burns nothing. Kit is already gone.

slips.name: Mira's Basket
slips.summary: Mira has a basket for Hesta and will not cross the market with the cat following.

steps.line: Mira ties the basket shut and tells the cat to stay. It does not.
Hesta takes the basket and the cat in the same breath.

slips.name: Tonic for the Inn
slips.summary: Maelin needs an antidote on the bar before night. She will not say for whom.

steps.line: Maelin pockets the antidote and does not thank you where anyone can hear.

slips.name: Salve for Pike
slips.summary: Pike burned his hands on the rope. He wants salve, not a lecture.

steps.line: Pike smears it on and goes back to the net like the pain was a rumor.

slips.name: Ether for the Chapel
slips.summary: Nia is out of ether for the people who come back shaking.

steps.line: Nia sets the ether with the candles. She says the chapel can breathe again.

slips.name: A Drink for the Gate
slips.summary: Holt's watch is fading. He will take a stamina potion and nothing else.

steps.line: Holt drinks it standing up. The gate looks the same. He does not.

slips.name: Hesta's Counter
slips.summary: Hesta sold the last health potion out of her own bag. She wants one back before noon.

steps.line: Hesta puts it under the counter, not on the shelf. That one is hers.

slips.name: Walk the Walls
slips.summary: Holt wants the gate, the east watch, and the pier looked at before he signs the day.

steps.line: Holt ticks three marks. The walls held. That is the report.

slips.name: The Lane Round
slips.summary: Rowan wants the alley, the well, and the square checked for anything the crier should not shout.

steps.line: Rowan writes 'quiet' and looks disappointed.

slips.name: Market to Kitchen
slips.summary: Hesta wants eyes on the market, the kitchen, and the pet store before she closes.

steps.line: Hesta closes the book. Nothing bit anyone. She calls that a good day.

slips.name: Seal to the Hall
slips.summary: Voss has a sealed note for Sera. He will not send it with Pipp.

steps.line: Voss hands you the seal and watches you put it away.
Sera breaks the seal, reads nothing aloud, and pins a fresh slip over the old one.

slips.name: Fenn's Warning
slips.summary: Fenn heard a shift never came back from the gate. Holt should hear it from a person, not a peg.

steps.line: Fenn gives you the name and tells you not to shout it in the yard.
Holt already has the name. He wanted it said anyway.

slips.name: From the Fields to a Bed
slips.summary: Bren found someone sitting in the stubble. Maelin has the bed. You have the walk.

steps.line: Bren points at a figure who stands when you do.
Maelin does not ask the name. The bowl is the welcome.

slips.name: Slime in the Cellar Stair
slips.summary: The Entry Tower's lower stair is slick. The hall wants the slimes thinned, not studied.

slips.name: Gargoyles on the Eaves
slips.summary: Gargoyles are dropping off the Entry Tower onto the road. Bren wants fewer of them.

steps.line: Bren points at the tower. He will not go up with you.
Bren counts you back. That is the whole ceremony.

slips.name: Brutes on the Road
slips.summary: Something heavy is walking off the Entry Tower. The hall calls them brutes and wretches and wants them gone.

slips.name: Harpy Hour
slips.summary: Bats and harpies are owning the hour before dusk. Pike cannot fish through it.

steps.line: Pike ducks a shadow and tells you the sky is your problem.
Pike looks up, sees nothing, and goes back to the net.

slips.name: Decoys in the Maze
slips.summary: Gambit's halls are leaving decoys on the town side of the mirror. The hall wants them broken.

slips.name: Cut the Strings
slips.summary: Marionettes and lures are walking people toward Gambit's gate. Sera wants the strings cut.

steps.line: Sera taps the slip. She does not say good luck.

slips.name: Lancers at the Gate
slips.summary: Centurion lancers are drilling where the town road used to be safe. Holt wants a count of them down.

steps.line: Holt gives you the direction and keeps the gate.

slips.name: The Pit's Echo
slips.summary: Gladiators and ironclads are still fighting a war the town did not declare.

slips.name: The Field Leak
slips.summary: Bren says slimes are leaking out of the tower onto the stubble. Thin them, then tell him.

steps.line: Bren shows you the shine on the grass. It is not dew.
Bren scrapes a boot clean and calls the field closed.

slips.name: Nell's Road
slips.summary: Nell will not walk the river road until the brutes on it are fewer. Then she wants to see you again.

steps.line: Nell points at the dark between lamps and stays where she is.
Nell steps onto the road. She does not take your arm this time.

slips.name: Dorr's Missing Count
slips.summary: Dorr lost two workers to something that came up the tower stair. He wants brutes, not condolences.

steps.line: Dorr gives you a whistle and tells you not to blow it unless you mean it.
Dorr takes the whistle back. The count is still short. The stair is quieter.

slips.name: Yenn's Bell
slips.summary: Yenn cannot ring the bell and watch the sky. Bats and harpies first, then the bell.

steps.line: Yenn keeps a hand on the rope and sends you up the story, not the watch.
Yenn rings once. The sky stays empty long enough.

slips.name: Quiet the Wraiths
slips.summary: Astral Tower is leaking wraiths into the reports. The hall pays in coin and one gem, and it does not post this often.

slips.name: Remnant Tide
slips.summary: Remnants and drifters are walking the rift like they have a town to get to. They do not.

slips.name: The Lich Watch
slips.summary: Eternal's liches and wails are in the chapel book. Nia will not read the page aloud. The hall will pay.

steps.line: Nia closes the book on a name she will not say.

slips.name: Harbinger Bell
slips.summary: A harbinger was heard from the east watch. Yenn wants it, and whatever vessel walked with it, gone.

steps.line: Yenn says she heard a bell that was not hers.

slips.name: Thin the Choir
slips.summary: The sunken ruins are singing again. The hall wants the choir thinner before anyone goes to listen.

slips.name: Break the Bluff
slips.summary: Gambit's own doubles are answering to the town's name. Sera wants the bluff broken, and she circled the gem twice.

steps.line: Sera circles the gem on the slip and does not smile.
